# ScrollCraft runtime

- Upstream: https://github.com/nateherkai/scroll-craft
- Commit: 75d81f74e83692add18cd7a8a8e078b8a887a579
- Path: plugins/nateherk-design/skills/scroll-craft/engine/
- License: MIT, preserved alongside the source.

`scrollcraft.js` and `scrollcraft.css` are unmodified copies. This application
loads the JavaScript only on the marketing home page. The upstream global CSS
reset is not loaded into the customer forms or operational screens; project art
direction and device styles are in `src/app/scroll-deneyimi.css`.
